checks: The original G is a sheaf on arbitrary X. Restriction along the actual open immersion evaluates the same G on image opens; the image/preimage adjunction proves finality in the actual restriction direction.

Every semilocal/local/fiber-product value is an actual scheme-neighborhood colimit. The general restriction and overlap arrows are induced by actual local-scheme morphisms and pullback projections, and commute with the chart comparisons on representatives.

The finite family only has to exhaust actual closed points of S. The general theorem does not require X affine, ambient selected points closed, local schemes open, or the extended presheaf already known to be a sheaf.

generalFinitePointValueIso and its naturality identify the actual original-X convention on j image sigma and the original natural map. The affine chart presents the given semilocalization; no unproved quasi-projective library theorem is claimed.

The explicit non-open example lives in the actual two-rational-point semilocalization of Spec Q[X][Y]. The chosen point is proved closed there; the actual map localToSemilocal has non-open image, hence is not an open immersion.

The non-open proof uses the full infinite family ker(Y-aX): each prime lies below the first selected maximal ideal but not below the second. A basic open inside the putative local image forces its defining polynomial into all these kernels; infinitely many distinct roots force it to zero. Smoothness, affineness and integrality of the original plane are proved.
The source theorem uses original H/G/eta on X, genuine S/open/local-scheme colimits and the original map induced by eta; it does not replace the canonical unit by an arbitrary isomorphism.

ambientMap_injective_iff and ambientMap_surjective_iff use the actual naturality square and its two canonical isomorphisms. The open restrictions and intersection restrictions commute with those isomorphisms.
ambientTwoOpen_exact_iff transports only the successful row along actual global, pair-of-open and intersection isomorphisms. Exactness is not postulated for the original unshrunk cover.

The actual two-closed-point comparison keeps exactly the given global/open injections, two local surjections (weaker than given isomorphisms), and successful point-preserving shrinking. It adds neither overlap surjectivity nor an extension-sheaf hypothesis.

The final bijective map is schemeNeighborhoodMap (semilocalToAmbient sigma composed with j) eta for the original eta. Since G need only be a sheaf and eta arbitrary with these conditions, the result specializes to the supplied canonical sheafification unit without needing a chart-chosen unit.
Restricted neighborhoods and inclusion are actual categories in the restriction direction. Intersection with the open W has a proved adjunction, giving finality of the opposite inclusion.

The canonical colimit.pre map is an isomorphism with its actual representative formula. The stronger theorem for arbitrary point sets implies the requested finite nonempty case without extra assumptions.

supplemental_independent_review.scope: Independent source-level audit of all five new modules and the resulting COVERAGE/alignment labels for GP003 S1/S2/S5. No repository file was written by this review; final full-case compiler output and axiom inventory are separate root integration evidence.

checks: AffineRestriction.lean:17-26 restricts the original presheaf and original natural map by the image-open functor of the actual open immersion. G remains the restriction of the original sheaf via the Mathlib sheaf-restriction theorem; no unrelated chart sheaf or map is substituted.

AffineRestriction.lean:28-57 constructs actual image/preimage neighborhood functors and their adjunction. Image is initial in inclusion order and therefore final after opposite, exactly the direction needed for restriction-directed colimits. Refining an original-X neighborhood to its chart intersection is justified by this construction.

AffineRestriction.lean:61-102 defines the canonical comparison using colimit.pre, proves its representative formula, and proves naturality in both the presheaf map and actual scheme-over-X restrictions. The isomorphism is not merely an abstract bijection between differently interpreted groups.

SchemeNeighborhoodValues.lean:15-64 indexes by actual factorizations T -> U.toScheme -> X, proves that these are equivalent to ambient image containment and that the lift is unique, and uses the opposite neighborhood category for the actual value. GeneralAmbient therefore retains original-X values rather than treating a scheme as its point-set image by definition.

ActualSemilocalGeometry.lean:22-99 uses the genuine localization ring, local schemes Spec(Localization.AtPrime q), their canonical maps to S, and the actual Scheme pullback over S. Its tensor-product scheme isomorphism and projection formula identify the correct fiber product. GeneralAmbient.lean:23-37 composes those same structural maps with j and retains both pullback projections; it does not replace the fiber product over S by a different product over X.

GeneralAmbient.lean:17-96 constructs the original-X global-to-local family and both actual fiber restrictions, proves transport for the family and overlap difference, and thus checks arrows as well as object groups.

GeneralAmbient.lean:102-156 transports the already-proved affine finite equalizer along explicit global/local/fiber isomorphisms. Its conclusion is injectivity plus image equal to the kernel of the genuine overlap difference, which is the requested equalizer in abelian groups. The only geometric family input is a finite family exhausting the closed points of S, already supplied by the S1 enumeration; no target exactness is assumed.

GeneralAmbient.lean:161-217 identifies original-X neighborhoods of j(sigma) with the image of the actual semilocalization and proves that the canonical natural map agrees with neighborhood_value_map. LocalizationNeighborhoods.lean:58-76 supplies the finite-prime generalization-image criterion without requiring any selected ambient prime to be closed.

The new theorems work for arbitrary X with an actual affine-chart presentation and arbitrary commutative chart ring. There is no perfect-field, infinite-field, ambient-closed-point, smoothness-of-the-localization-map, or local-open-immersion assumption. In particular the stated stronger theorem specializes to the smooth quasi-projective semilocal presentation without strengthening its mathematical assumptions.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:66-85 defines the actual polynomial plane Q[X][Y] and rational points as kernels of (X,Y)->(0,b). Surjectivity of the evaluation map proves point b is maximal. The selected finite nonempty set consists of point 0 and point 1, both genuine rational points of this affine plane.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:129-150 chooses an actual prime closedPoint of the genuine finite-point localization lying over point 1, proves its contraction, and proves it is closed in the semilocal S by maximal ideal transport. It is therefore a valid S1 x_i, rather than an arbitrary ambient or generic point.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:20-60 proves nonopenness over S itself. If the local image in Spec M^-1R were open, the localization-spectrum embedding would supply an ambient open U and a basic D(a) around the contracted q. Every excluded prime from the specified family would contain a, forcing a=0 and contradicting membership of q in D(a). The target map is localToSemilocal q, not just localToAmbient q.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:87-120 supplies every prime-family input concretely: ker(Y-aX) is below the origin, is not below point 1 because Y-aX evaluates to 1 there, and the intersection of these kernels is zero by infinitely many distinct polynomial roots aX. No nonopen conclusion is included as a family assumption.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:155-170 concludes that the image of localToSemilocal closedPoint is not open and consequently that this actual local scheme map is not an open immersion. This closes the required need-not-be-open clause in the semilocal setting.

GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean:172-191 defines the original affinePlane and its projection to Spec Q, proves it affine and integral, and proves smoothness by composing the two polynomial smooth algebras. The witness is the ordinary smooth affine plane, which lies in the task smooth quasi-projective class; it is not a non-noetherian surrogate example.

COVERAGE and alignment explicitly retain the chart-as-presentation convention already reviewed, so complete S1 means the original-X descent plus actual local/pullback objects and the genuine nonopen example. They do not claim a new theorem extracting a chart from a formal IsQuasiProjective instance.

formalization_boundaries.detail: The new theorem accepts an actual open immersion Spec R -> X and proves the equalizer/comparison for the localization presented there, for any original X. Thus X itself is not restricted to be affine. Taking this chart as the construction data of the given semilocalization is mathematically legitimate. These files do not encode an IsQuasiProjective structure and then construct a common affine chart for an arbitrary finite set, nor do they prove chart-independence of the abstract semilocal scheme construction. Do not describe those geometric construction facts as newly compiled results from these modules.

The new finite assembly and original-unit naturality are proved conditionally on genuine geometric inputs. Those inputs remain uninstantiated for the actual HI presheaf with transfers and are not promoted into the original task assumptions.

supplemental_independent_review.summary: S1 and S2 pass source-level semantic review under the explicitly stated semilocal-chart presentation convention; the genuine semilocal non-open witness closes the prior S1 clause. S5 remains partial: its new finite assembly and original-unit recovery are honest conditional helpers whose transfer-geometry inputs are not proved.

resolved_findings.detail: The proof correctly avoids assuming localToSemilocal q is open, but this absence alone does not prove the explicit need-not-be-open clause. A witness must concern the localization S_i -> the semilocal S in the task. Nonopenness of an ambient Spec R_p -> Spec R with nonsemilocal Spec R would not alone satisfy it; n=1 gives identity over S and cannot witness the clause.
resolved_findings.resolution: GeneralAmbientNonOpen.lean proves the non-open image and non-open-immersion conclusions for a genuine closed point of the two-point semilocalization of the smooth rational affine plane.
